rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person who is honest and tells the truth.

example.traditional: 你老實講，件事係咪你做㗎？
example.jyutping: nei5 lou5 sat6 gong2 gin6 si6 hai6 mai6 nei5 zou6 gaa4

rows.note: Use this when a depiction matches reality or looks true to life.

example.english: The film gives a truthful picture of village life.
example.traditional: 套戲入面嘅鄉村生活拍得好真實。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 ge3 hoeng1 cyun1 saang1 wut6 paak3 dak1 hou2 zan1 sat6

rows.note: Use this written-leaning choice when stressing that a depiction faithfully follows the original or the facts.

example.english: This translation gives a truthful account of the original's tone.
example.traditional: 呢個譯本對原著嘅語氣保留得好忠實。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 jik6 bun2 deoi3 jyun4 zyu3 ge3 jyu5 hei3 bou2 lau4 dak1 hou2 zung1 sat6
